THE E03 REVIEW MADE THE BEST CATCH OF THE PROGRAMME SO FAR AND IT REPRODUCED IT LIVE: it re-ran devs-refresh with no token against a 1,036-note corpus copy, the log carried 273 lines of 'GitHub 403 API rate limit exceeded', and the run still printed healthy: true with the publish set collapsed from 1,316 to 31. simonw himself dropped to the provenance floor. Root cause: Budget.truncated is set only on budget exhaustion, never on 403s, and resolve failures were counted nowhere. Fixed by counting errors at the client rather than at each swallow, because the swallows are not all reachable (owner_resolve returns None on a failed contributors call, indistinguishable from 'no human found'), and a 404 is deliberately NOT counted because it is an answer, not a failure, and a predicate that cries wolf gets muted.
